title: Niagara Falls Small Group Night Tour with Fallsview Dinner
includes: Illumination Tower Control Room Access (Admission Included)
Free pick up and drop off from Niagara Falls Canada or USA
Dinner at a Local Restaurant (Included in Price)
A complimentary “I Lit up Niagara Falls” certificate
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your adventure begins with your local friendly guide picking you up directly from your downtown Niagara Falls hotel. From there, you will make your way to dinner. 

You will enjoy a delicious dinner at a local restaurant.

Once you have finished your meal, your guide will lead you to the Illumination Tower. There you will experience the illumination of the falls against the night sky. You will be amazed by the multi-colored water and light masterpiece. As an added bonus, our guests then have the opportunity to get creative and control the lights themselves! Before exiting the tower, you will be presented with an “I Lit Up Niagara Falls” certificate as a keepsake from this exclusive experience.
